    The thin representation from a point #

    Assume parallel paths of a piece have equal composites (Lemma 4.2). For a point x, let gval y : x → y be the composite of any path from x to y (zero if there is none). The representation thinRep x has k at every point, and an arrow e acts by 1 if gval (src e) ≫ e ≠ 0 and by 0 otherwise. It respects the cover (respectsCover_thinRep), and a path from x with nonzero composite acts nonzero on it, so its word is nonzero in the piece algebra (pmk_word_ne_zero).

    compD S (l ++ l') i m ⋯ = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp (compD S l i j h) (compD S l' j m h')
